{{Top|leg}}
'''Director of Prosthetic Design''' was a title in the corporation [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Saren Llalik]], expert on [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] technology, held this rank.<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>

Only the Director of Prosthetic Design could order a thorough analysis on the [[2-1B/Legends|2-1B]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of BioTech's headquarters. Doctor Llalik had sabotaged her 2-1B with an [[Espionage droid|espionage module]], knowing that nobody could discover her trick.<ref name="CRO" />
